summary.en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber on Nov 5, a vulnerability-research model scoring 48.5% on ExploitGym (vs 32.1% for its predecessor) and credited with 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox flaws and working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities. Rated Critical under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, it is limited to approved Daybreak Red customers at $20/$100 per million tokens. Exploit figures are OpenAI's own claims.
summary.zh-TW: OpenAI 11/5 發布專攻漏洞研究的 GPT-6 Cyber：ExploitGym 成績 48.5%（前代 32.1%），宣稱找出 81 個 Firefox 未知高危漏洞、為 948 個 Linux 核心漏洞寫出可用 exploit。因能力太強被 OpenAI 自評為 Critical 等級，只透過 Daybreak Red 計畫開放給審核通過的客戶，API 定價 $20/$100 每百萬 tokens。漏洞數字為 OpenAI 自報，尚待第三方核實。

title.en: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, restricted to approved security customers
title.zh-TW: OpenAI 發布 GPT-6 Cyber 資安模型，僅供審核通過的客戶使用

verifiedNote.en: Verified by the AI morning digest desk on 2026-11-06, cross-checked across VentureBeat, eyssen.ai's daily roundup and SXF Brief; exploit counts are OpenAI's own claims and are flagged as such.
verifiedNote.zh-TW: AI 早報線於 2026-11-06 查證，交叉核對 VentureBeat、eyssen.ai 每日彙整與 SXF Brief，三方數字一致；漏洞數為 OpenAI 自報，已於摘要註明。

summary.en: Google DeepMind made its Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model generally available on Nov 5 via the Gemini API and Gemini for business: native clip length rises from 10 to 15 seconds with 1-second increments, multi-turn conversational editing and stronger reference following. 720p pricing drops 30% to $0.07 per second (about $1.05 per 15-second clip). Google published no benchmark scores for 1.2.
summary.zh-TW: Google DeepMind 11/5 讓影片模型 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 正式上線（Gemini API 與企業版）：原生片長從 10 秒拉到 15 秒、可逐秒指定 3–15 秒、支援多輪對話式剪輯與更強的參考圖跟隨；720p 定價 $0.07/秒，較前代降 30%，一段 15 秒片約 $1.05。Google 未公布 1.2 版的 benchmark 成績。

title.en: Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash goes GA: native 15-second video, 30% cheaper
title.zh-TW: Google Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 正式上線：原生 15 秒影片、降價 30%

verifiedNote.en: Verified by the AI morning digest desk on 2026-11-06 against Google's official blog post, cross-checked with MarkTechPost and Gadgets 360; clip length and pricing match.
verifiedNote.zh-TW: AI 早報線於 2026-11-06 查證，依據 Google 官方部落格原文，交叉核對 MarkTechPost 與 Gadgets 360，片長與定價一致。

summary.en: Independent evaluator METR published a high-access assessment of Anthropic on Nov 5: progress on its AECI capability index has run at an estimated 1.9x the pre-October-2025 rate (95% CI 1.5–2.8), with METR's subjective guess that ~80% of the acceleration comes from AI itself rather than compute or headcount. METR stresses high uncertainty (a true value of 1.3x or 3x would not surprise it) and notes Anthropic redacted a majority of the most informative evidence.
summary.zh-TW: 獨立評測機構 METR 11/5 發布對 Anthropic 的高權限評估：其能力指數（AECI）自 2025 年 10 月以來進步速度約為先前的 1.9 倍（95% 信賴區間 1.5–2.8），METR 主觀估計約 80% 的加速來自 AI 本身而非算力或人力。但 METR 明說不確定性高（真值 1.3 或 3 倍都不意外），且 Anthropic 刪去了多數最關鍵證據，外部無法完整稽核。

title.en: METR: Anthropic's model progress accelerated ~1.9x, mostly driven by AI itself
title.zh-TW: METR 評估：Anthropic 的模型進步速度約變快 1.9 倍，多數來自 AI 自身

verifiedNote.en: Verified by the AI morning digest desk on 2026-11-06, cross-checked across AI Stock Wire, LessCarbs and XenoSpectrum summaries of the METR report; the 1.9x figure and interval match, and the redaction caveat is METR's own.
verifiedNote.zh-TW: AI 早報線於 2026-11-06 查證，交叉核對 AI Stock Wire、LessCarbs 與 XenoSpectrum 對 METR 報告的整理，1.9 倍與區間數字一致；證據刪減一事為 METR 自述。

summary.en: Anthropic launched Personal Finance in Claude on Nov 5 as a US beta for Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers: users link up to 16 banks' bank, card, loan and investment accounts read-only through Plaid and ask plain-language questions about spending, balances and bills. Claude can read balances, limits and up to 24 months of transactions but cannot move, manage or invest money, and these chats are not used for training.
summary.zh-TW: Anthropic 11/5 推出 Claude 的 Personal Finance beta：美國 Pro／Max／Ultra 用戶可透過 Plaid 唯讀連結最多 16 家銀行的帳戶、卡片、貸款與投資帳戶，用白話問自己的收支、餘額與帳單。Claude 看得到餘額、額度與最長 24 個月交易紀錄，但不能移轉、管理或投資任何錢，相關對話不用於模型訓練。

title.en: Claude launches Personal Finance: read-only bank linking in US beta
title.zh-TW: Claude 推出 Personal Finance：唯讀連結銀行帳戶（美國 beta）

verifiedNote.en: Verified by the AI morning digest desk on 2026-11-06, cross-checked across MLQ, Tiller and PromptWises, all citing Anthropic's announcement and Help Center; plan scope and read-only limits match.
verifiedNote.zh-TW: AI 早報線於 2026-11-06 查證，交叉核對 MLQ、Tiller 與 PromptWises，皆引用 Anthropic 官方公告與 Help Center，方案範圍與唯讀限制一致。

summary.en: Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope on Nov 5 (FP8 and BF16): a sparse MoE with 280B total parameters and only 14B active per token, pretrained from scratch on 33.5T tokens, with up to 1M-token context for fine-tuning and inference. It is a raw pre-training checkpoint with no post-training, under a custom license that excludes the EU/UK/South Korea and requires separate authorization above $50M in related annual revenue; benchmark figures are Baidu's own.
summary.zh-TW: 百度 11/5 在 Hugging Face 與 ModelScope 放出 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 權重（FP8 與 BF16）：稀疏 MoE 架構，總參數 280B、每 token 只啟用 14B，以 33.5 兆 tokens 從零預訓練，微調與推論支援最長 100 萬 tokens 上下文。注意這是未經後訓練的原始 base 模型，且採自訂授權（排除歐盟／英國／韓國，相關年營收逾 5,000 萬美元需另行授權）；跑分皆為百度自測。

title.en: Baidu open-sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base weights: 280B total, 14B active
title.zh-TW: 百度開源 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 權重：280B 總參數、僅 14B 啟用

verifiedNote.en: Verified by the AI morning digest desk on 2026-11-06, cross-checked across Tech-Insider, SuperPowerDaily and ModelFit's reading of the official model card; parameters and license terms match.
verifiedNote.zh-TW: AI 早報線於 2026-11-06 查證，交叉核對 Tech-Insider、SuperPowerDaily 與 ModelFit 對官方 model card 的整理，參數與授權條款一致。

summary.en: Dropbox announced on Nov 5 that it will acquire Tigris Data, a globally distributed S3-compatible object storage platform built for AI workloads, for approximately $350 million in cash — its largest acquisition since its 2007 founding — alongside the launch of DBX Agent Cloud for AI developers. The deal is expected to close in Q4 2026 and has not yet closed.
summary.zh-TW: Dropbox 11/5 宣布以約 3.5 億美元現金收購分散式物件儲存新創 Tigris Data（S3 相容、主打 AI 工作負載），是它 2007 年創立以來最大收購案；同時推出面向 AI 開發者的 DBX Agent Cloud 儲存平台。交易預計 2026 年 Q4 完成，尚未交割。

title.en: Dropbox to acquire Tigris Data for ~$350M in AI infrastructure push
title.zh-TW: Dropbox 以約 3.5 億美元收購 Tigris Data，跨入 AI 基礎設施

verifiedNote.en: Verified by the AI morning digest desk on 2026-11-06 against Dropbox's Q3 results release on Business Wire, cross-checked with TechCrunch reporting and the Motley Fool earnings-call transcript; price and timeline match.
verifiedNote.zh-TW: AI 早報線於 2026-11-06 查證，依據 Dropbox 經 Business Wire 發布的 Q3 財報原文，交叉核對 TechCrunch 報導與 Motley Fool 法說會逐字稿，金額與時程一致。

summary.en: Cursor launched Build Live Apps on Nov 5: its cloud agents now scaffold the web app, provision a Postgres database, wire up Cursor SSO authentication and hosting, and return a shareable live link, gated by deterministic and agentic security checks before publishing. It is available on all paid plans with cloud agents enabled, deploying from Cursor Origin or GitHub, with GitLab support coming.
summary.zh-TW: Cursor 11/5 推出 Build Live Apps：雲端 agent 不只寫程式，還會自動架好 Postgres 資料庫、Cursor SSO 登入與託管，給你一個可分享的正式連結，上線前先跑確定性與 agent 式安全檢查。所有付費方案（需啟用雲端 agent）可用，可從 Cursor Origin 或 GitHub 部署，GitLab 支援稍後推出。

title.en: Cursor ships Build Live Apps: from code generation to hosted deployment
title.zh-TW: Cursor 推出 Build Live Apps：從寫程式一路做到上線託管

verifiedNote.en: Verified by the AI morning digest desk on 2026-11-06, cross-checked across StartupHub, yet-another-changelog and server4agent summaries of Cursor's official changelog; features and plan scope match.

summary.en: Anthropic struck its first paid news licensing deal, with the Associated Press, just ahead of the US midterms, according to Adweek: Claude showed live, attributed AP polling and election data on election night. It is a reversal for a company that had argued scraping was fair use and declined licensing. Financial terms and duration were not disclosed, and neither side commented on the record.
summary.zh-TW: 據 Adweek 報導，Anthropic 在美國期中選舉前與美聯社（AP）簽下首份付費新聞授權，讓 Claude 在選舉夜顯示即時民調與選情並註明出處——這家先前主張抓取屬合理使用、拒絕授權的公司首度轉向。金額與期限未公開，兩家公司都未正式回應證實。

title.en: Anthropic pays for news for the first time in AP licensing deal
title.zh-TW: Anthropic 首度付費買新聞：與美聯社簽選舉資料授權
